visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-opening image with a headline and call to action
visualCharacteristics.layout: Background image fills the block; content row sits on top
visualCharacteristics.home: Full-bleed photo with a centered H2 headline and a CTA button below it
visualCharacteristics.page: Page header on white: H1 and one or more subtitle paragraphs on the left, photo with a large rounded bottom-left corner on the right from 900px; photo stacks above the text on mobile

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: heading (H1 or H2) and an optional CTA link in its own paragraph
contentPattern.example: Background image, H2 'A great place to do meaningful work.', CTA 'Find Your Next Role'
contentPattern.page: row 1: photo; row 2: H1 followed by one or more subtitle paragraphs (no CTA)

notes: Growth & development page header: authored as 'Hero (page)' (variant hero-page)

reuseGuidance: Use plain 'Hero' for the boilerplate left-aligned hero; add the 'home' option for the full-bleed centered homepage hero. A lone link in the content row becomes a button under 'home'. Add the 'page' option for interior page headers: H1 and subtitle text beside a photo with a rounded corner.
